name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home before the painters arrive?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do anything to prepare my home before the painters arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: While professional painters will handle much of the preparation, there are steps you can take to help streamline the process. It's helpful to remove small, delicate, or valuable items from the rooms being painted, such as picture frames, wall decor, and collectibles. Clearing pathways and moving larger furniture away from walls, if possible, can also be beneficial. This allows the painting crew to set up drop cloths and begin work more efficiently, ensuring a smoother project start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before painters arrive, remove small, delicate items and clear pathways. Moving larger furniture away from walls can also help streamline the preparation process.
